description: Never ship a deck without a valid visual-review decision; never block without a retry path. Per page: 3 review attempts with 3 exponential-backoff transient retries each, then 1 whole-deck retry pass, then REVIEW_REQUIRED with no delivery PDF. userStories.title: Transient retry helper with exponential backoff

userStories.title: Per-page review+repair loop (3 attempts)
userStories.description: review_page builds -> scores via the reviewer -> if below threshold, runs the conductor repair (if any) and rebuilds, up to max_attempts=3. A page the reviewer cannot score is 'unreviewable'; a page that never reaches threshold is 'rejected'.
acceptanceCriteria: review_page(build_fn, reviewer, page_png=, refs=, row_ids=, max_attempts=3, threshold=3, conductor=None) returns {'passed','verdict','attempts','scores'}
A page that passes on rebuild 2 returns passed with 2 build calls
A page that never passes returns verdict 'rejected' after 3 attempts
An unreviewable page (reviewer returns None) returns verdict 'unreviewable'

userStories.title: Whole-deck retry pass + REVIEW_REQUIRED decision
userStories.description: run_visual_review_loop builds, reviews every page, then one whole-deck retry re-reviews only failed pages. If all pass -> review_candidate; else -> review_required. Never produces a delivery PDF; ship_ready stays owned by the calibrated gate.
acceptanceCriteria: run_visual_review_loop(...) returns {release_state, delivery_pdf_bytes: None, attempt_records, whole_deck_passes, page_outcomes}
A deck with one failing page returns review_required with delivery_pdf_bytes None
A deck where all pages pass returns review_candidate
The whole-deck pass runs exactly once (whole_deck_passes == 1) and only re-reviews failed pages
